rules.DUPLICATE: Exact duplicate of another row (same times, zones, vendor, distance, total); keep first.
rules.PICKUP_OUTSIDE_MONTH: Pickup timestamp not in the file's month (e.g. year 2008 or next month spill-over).
rules.NONPOSITIVE_DURATION: Drop-off at or before pickup; trip time cannot be measured.
rules.DURATION_OVER_MAX: Trip longer than 180 min; meter left running or clock error.
rules.ZERO_DISTANCE: Trip distance <= 0 miles; no movement recorded.
rules.DISTANCE_OVER_MAX: Trip distance > 100.0 miles; outside NYC metro envelope.
rules.IMPLAUSIBLE_SPEED: Implied average speed > 80.0 mph; distance/time inconsistent.
rules.UNKNOWN_PICKUP_ZONE: Pickup zone is 'Unknown'/'Outside NYC' or not in the TLC zone lookup.
rules.UNKNOWN_DROPOFF_ZONE: Drop-off zone is 'Unknown'/'Outside NYC' or not in the TLC zone lookup.
rules.NONPOSITIVE_TOTAL: total_amount <= 0; void, refund or dispute, not a revenue trip.
